text:
Quinn: idea - introduce a 'staged-toggle' runtime primitive for gradual config changes (flags/routes/quotas). goal: safe sweeps + observable rollback without manual chase.

Anya: console UX thoughts - need a diff preview, per-stage progress, inline logs, and a single big red "abort" button. also preview percentages before apply. :warning:

Bryan: API shape suggestion - typed `stages: [{target_percent, duration_mins, checks, min_samples, quorum}]` + `snapshot_id` and `dry_run` flags. prefer consistent field names over freeform scripts.

Raj: telemetry reqs - tag requests with `staged_id`, emit `staged_apply_start`/`end` events, and record per-stage histograms for latency/errors. careful with metric cardinality; bucket cohorts by hashed tranche.

Leo: ops constraints - require `min_samples` per stage and a cooldown between stages (default 2x stage duration). use a rolling-window aggregation (e.g., 3x1m windows) to avoid transient flips. rollback if metric breaches for N consecutive windows.

Sumi: router detail - cohort calculation should be deterministic: hash(tenant_id, staged_id, seed) % 100 < target_percent. router must be idempotent and emit `cohort_id` in traces so we can slice. fallback options: `route_variant`, `quota_scale_down`, or `blackhole` (for safe drain).

Maya: product ask - support a "preview" first stage that doesn't change billing or quotas (visual only) so we can validate UX and logs. also add a confirm modal when % > 50.

Bryan: include `abort_reason` enum (metric_violation, manual, dependency_fail) in audit events and make all applies write to an audit log + immutable snapshot.

Anya: timeline UI - small cards per stage with green/yellow/red status, a live console panel showing last 200 events, and an accessibility path (keyboard focus + ARIA labels).

Raj: sampling - bump trace sampling for affected cohorts to 100% for first 5 minutes, then decay. also emit a `staged_metric_breakdown` dataset to help SRE debug.

Leo: implementation note - rollout must go router -> quota -> billing in a single logical transaction with idempotent retries. if billing adapter fails, rollback that cohort only and surface clear error in timeline.

Sumi: quick proto snippet: ```json
{
  "staged_id":"stg-2026-07",
  "snapshot_id":"snap-9898",
  "stages":[
    {"target_percent":3, "duration_mins":20, "checks":["p95<180","error_rate<0.5%"], "min_samples":200, "quorum":0.75},
    {"target_percent":20, "duration_mins":30, "checks":["p95<220","error_rate<1%"], "min_samples":1000, "quorum":0.8},
    {"target_percent":100, "duration_mins":0}
  ],
  "fallback":{"type":"quota_scale_down","scale":0.7},
  "dry_run":true
}
```

Maya: thumbs up - i'll add product acceptance criteria in the RFC: preview, confirm modals, audit entries, and billing-exclusion for preview stage.

Bryan: i'll draft the protobuf and include unit tests for idempotency and schema validation.

Raj: i'll write the telemetry contract and a small query bundle for SRE to use (Grafana + trace links).

Leo: i'll mock a simulator for threshold sensitivity and share results in the RFC.

Anya: i'll wire up the timeline mock and accessibility checklist, then hand to design for polish.

deploy-bot: PR opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4502 - staged-toggle API + console hooks. CI: ✅ unit, ⚠️ integration flaky on quota-sim.

Quinn: thanks team - i'll own the RFC and sync. volunteers: Bryan (api), Raj (telemetry), Anya (ux), Leo (ops), Maya (product). ping here when RFC is live. :metal:
